concept.movement: A long plated centipede creeps on twelve pairs of pointed tarsi with a readable traveling leg wave and many simultaneous contacts. Faster movement quickens and lengthens the same wave while the armor stays close to level. The head probes forward and the centered rear fork follows the body gently.
concept.attack: The rear and middle feet brace as the front segments draw back slightly, then drive the head and its two whole curved mouth branches forward into a rapid opening-and-closing bite. The antennae and complete eyes follow the head coherently.
concept.death: The head sinks forward, followed by a restrained collapse traveling toward the rear. The actual ventral regions along the long segmented body settle on the floor while each walking pair releases outward and the rear fork stays centered. The corpse ends still without balancing only on its face or appendage tips.
